subject: SLA pricing and pilot concession for Lakeshore AI
messages:
From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@lakeshore.ai>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@lakeshore.ai
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Initial ask — SLA tiers + pilot discount for Lakeshore pilot

Hi Mateo,

Hope you're doing well — thanks again for the product demo last week. We're preparing an internal procurement brief for a 3-month pilot and need a concrete SLA/pricing layout to present. High-level asks below: 

- Target uptime: 99.95% for hosted inference in us-west; can you map the closest tier and delta in credits?
- Response windows: we need an assertion on P1 (1 hour) / P2 (4 hours) response times and how that maps to retainer vs on-demand triage.
- Pilot pricing: Lakeshore is asking for a pilot concession (one-time credit) if we commit to a 6-month review after the pilot.

Can you send a short doc we can attach to procurement (SLA table + a simple concession option)? Would appreciate something we can review internally by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Aisha Patel
Head of ML Ops | Lakeshore AI
[Attachment: current-usage-estimate.csv (CSV)]

From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@lakeshore.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial ask — SLA tiers + pilot discount for Lakeshore pilot

Hi Aisha — thanks for the note and great meeting earlier. Drafting a compact SLA/pricing summary for procurement attached. Highlights up front: 

- Recommended tier: \"Gold (99.95%)\" for hosted API in us-west. Standard credit: 5% monthly credit for availability below target.
- Response times (Gold): P1 = 1 hour (phone bridge + escalation), P2 = 4 hours (email + ticket triage). P1 incidents during pilot will be included in our standard support hours; P1 after business hours can be covered with a retainer.
- Pilot concession proposal: one-time $10k service credit applied against first invoice if Lakeshore signs a 6-month post-pilot commitment (minimum $50k committed monthly).

I've attached: SLA_Tiers_20261129.pdf (summary table), LA_Pilot_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (timeline + success criteria), redwood-pricing-term-sheet-v2.pdf (term summary).

Quick next steps:
1) Tell me if the credit + commit aligns with procurement expectations.
2) If yes, I'll loop legal for a short addendum and send a DocuSign link.

Thanks — Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SLA_Tiers_20261129.pdf (PDF); LA_Pilot_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (XLSX); redwood-pricing-term-sheet-v2.pdf (PDF)]

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 13:20:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: concession math and approval path (Lakeshore)

Folks — quick alignment note before we send anything final to Aisha: 

- $10k service credit sounds reasonable for a pilot that leads to a $50k/mo commit, but finance wants the concession scoped: credit applies to onboarding fees only, not recurring usage, unless AE confirms usage floors.
- If they push to apply credit to usage, we should ask for a minimum committed token volume or a minimum monthly invoice guarantee for the first 3 months.
- Legal will need a 1-paragraph addendum stating the credit conditions and that it's a one-time non-transferable credit.

Proposed reply to Aisha (I can send): include the Gold tier bullet list, clarify credit applies to onboarding/implementation fees, offer to escalate to Director of Sales if they want credit applied against usage.

Laura Bennett
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@lakeshore.ai>

Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:09:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SLA pricing and pilot concession for Lakeshore AI

Hi Mateo — thanks, the doc looks good and concise. Procurement is pushing back slightly: they prefer the credit be applied to the first two months of usage rather than onboarding fees. Their rationale: our usage estimate is front-loaded in month 1 and 2 due to dataset ingestion.

Can Redwood make an exception to apply up to $10k credit against usage for the first two months (capped at actual invoice)? If not possible, we'll look to shift to a smaller usage credit + a reduced onboarding fee.

Also, procurement asked for a simple call (15 min) with someone in pricing/finance to confirm the math — can you set that up tomorrow?

Best,
Aisha

Subject: Re: Internal: concession math and approval path (Lakeshore)

Laura / Mateo — Finance confirmed a limited exception: we can apply the $10k credit against usage invoices for months 1–2 of the pilot, capped at actual invoiced amount and only when usage invoices exceed $2k/month. Conditions to document: 

- Credit is one-time, non-transferable, applied pro rata across first two monthly usage invoices up to $10k total.
- Requires signature on the standard pilot MSA + the 6-month post-pilot commitment term sheet (Deal ID: DEAL-4895).
- Lakeshore must provide the agreed usage estimate (attached to the MAPP) as part of onboarding; if estimate deviates >30% downward, credit eligibility is reduced proportionally.

I'll approve this with Legal if you (Mateo) confirm and ask Legal to draft the simple addendum (1 paragraph) for signature. Laura — please send the updated reply to Aisha so we can lock the timeline.

Ben Carter
VP, Commercial Strategy | Redwood Inference
